slides.title: Is this still your Core Customer?
slides.support: In Metronome: open War Room. Read your Core Customer aloud.
body: Is this still the customer you most want more of?
Are their three needs still right, in the same order?
What did the year teach you about them?
notes: The team chose one Core Customer at Q2 and ranked their three needs. A year of selling to them tests that choice.
Change only what the evidence changes. The differentiators the team builds this afternoon must serve these needs.
slides.headline: Is this still your Core Customer?

slides.title: Is your 3HAG line agreed?
slides.support: In Metronome: open War Room. Put your Attribution Framework on the screen.
body: Read the line: where you will lead, what you maintain and what you let drop.
Has anything changed since you drew it?
Agree the line now. The differentiators are built from it.
notes: The team drew its 3HAG line last quarter and slept on it. The differentiators need the whole line agreed before they start.
If the team cannot score its competitors with confidence, stop and set the research as homework. Do not build differentiators on a guess.
slides.headline: Is your 3HAG line agreed?
